title: Subject Usage Information in Name Authority Records
summary: Describes the 667 SUBJECT USAGE note in name authority records, which records subject-cataloging information such as a name heading not being valid for subject use (and which heading to use instead) or a scope note for subject usage. A validator should treat a name heading whose NAR carries "This heading is not valid for use as a subject" as invalid in a subject string and substitute the heading named. Geographic-subdivision usage is now carried in field 781 (H 835), not in this note.
validation_rules: A name heading whose authority record has a 667 note beginning `SUBJECT USAGE: This heading is not valid for use as a subject.` must not be used as a subject heading; use the heading named in the note instead. (H 432, Background)
A former name of a jurisdiction that has undergone a linear name change is not valid as a subject; use the later name, e.g., not `Ceylon` but `Sri Lanka` (see H 708). (H 432, Background)
Do not use `Commune de Paris (France : 1871)` as a subject; use `Paris (France)--History--Commune, 1871`. (H 432, Background)

Do not use the corporate heading for a head of state's office (e.g., `United States. President (1801-1809 : Jefferson)`) as a subject; use the personal name (`Jefferson, Thomas, 1743-1826`). (H 432, Background)

A 667 SUBJECT USAGE scope note may distinguish uses of a name heading from a related subject heading, e.g., `Musée du Louvre` for works on the museum, `Louvre (Paris, France)` for works on the building. (H 432, Background)
Information on using geographic headings as subdivisions is carried in field 781, not the 667 field (see H 835). (H 432, Background)
